+title: The body of the session agent renders with the tool selection of the session agent
+---
+## What
+Since ^1et93gh, the skills registry of a session gets its template values `tools.<group>.enabled` after the session agent is resolved, thus a skill and the `skills:` preload follow the `tools:` and `disallowedTools:` keys of the session agent.
+
+The body of the session agent itself does not follow. `AgentRunner.sessionAgentInstructions(for:)` renders the body with `AgentBodyRenderer`, which reads `AgentRegistry.templateContext`. The session resolves its agent from that registry, thus the registry is made before the selection is known (`AgentsComposition.makeAgentRegistry` uses the values of the configuration). A body with `{% if tools.shell.enabled %}` thus tells the steps of a tool that the session does not have.
+
+Also: the agent runs share the one skills registry of the session (one `AgentEnvironment`). After ^1et93gh a run sees the values of the root session agent, not the values of its own tools. The pinned packages give no per-run template context.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] A session agent with `disallowedTools: [shell]` renders its own body with `tools.shell.enabled` as `false`.
+- [ ] A session agent with no `tools:` key renders its body with the same values as today.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] A unit test for each criterion.
+- [ ] `swift test` passes with no warnings.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd`. #step1
\ No newline at end of file

 assignees:

+comments:
+- actor: claude-code
+  id: 01m77qt7m9mg61abbzv0abe3r0
+  text: |-
+    Research (implement step).
+
+    Findings:
+    - `AgentRunner.sessionAgentInstructions(for:)` renders the body with `renderer.render(definition, prompt: "")`. `AgentBodyRenderer` is internal. It copies `registry.templateContext` in `AgentRunner.init`. `AgentRegistry.templateContext` is a `let`. Thus the pinned FoundationModelsAgents gives no public way to render a body with other template values.
+    - `SessionSetup.composeSession` must load the agent registry before it resolves the session agent. The surface then uses the same registry for the `agents` tool and the runner. Thus the registry has the configuration values (`AgentsComposition.makeAgentRegistry`).
+    - An agent run renders its body in `AgentSessionMaker.resolveSetup` with the same renderer, and its `skills:` preload with `environment.skillsPreload`, which calls `SkillsRegistry.call(id:)`. `SkillsRegistry` has no per-call template values. Thus per-run values need a new API in FoundationModelsAgents and in FoundationModelsSkills.
+    - In this host, the run tools are `searchTools` and `runCode` over the root Multitool registry (`AgentsComposition.makeRunTools`), plus `skills` and `agents`. The tool groups of a run thus come from the resolved tool names of the run.
+
+    Rejected workarounds (they build around the missing API):
+    - A second render-only `AgentRegistry` and a second `AgentRunner` over the session environment. `AgentRunner.init` starts an `AgentSearch` task and a scheduler, and the search holds the embedder of the profile.
+    - Two loads of the agent registry: one with the configuration values for the resolution, then one with the values of the session agent for the surface. This works with the current API, but it reads all agent layers two times for each session, and the runs then render with the values of the root session agent. The orchestrator must decide if this is acceptable.
+
+    No file is changed.
